name: Telegram OIDC authentication through Clerk
manualSteps: Create or reuse a Telegram bot and obtain its OIDC client credentials through @BotFather Login Widget settings.
Configure a Clerk custom social provider using https://oauth.telegram.org/.well-known/openid-configuration with PKCE.
Register Clerk's exact redirect URI in Telegram and deliberately map Telegram identities that may not include email.
Create or reuse a Telegram bot and obtain its OIDC client credentials through @BotFather Login Widget settings.
Configure a Clerk custom social provider using https://oauth.telegram.org/.well-known/openid-configuration with PKCE.
Register Clerk's exact redirect URI in Telegram and deliberately map Telegram identities that may not include email.
Use the same Clerk application configured with Telegram OIDC on the frontend.
Verify a Telegram-authenticated Clerk identity reaches a protected API route.
Do not store the Telegram OIDC client secret in Express; Clerk owns it.
